name: svgator
description: Create, edit, organize, and export SVGator animations through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your SVGator account to browse, inspect, create, edit, organize, and export animated SVG projects. Start from scratch, or search SVGator's library of ready-made animation templates (loaders, icons, logos, UI elements, ad designs) and duplicate one to work from. Use natural language to make precise changes to shapes, colors, timing, and animation keyframes, then export animated or static SVG, Lottie, React Native, Flutter, GIF, or video files. SVGator accesses only the account you connect; export availability follows your SVGator plan.
defaultPrompt: Show me the structure of one of my SVGator projects.
Export my SVGator animation as an animated SVG.

publication.release_notes:
SVGator in ChatGPT: connect your SVGator account over OAuth and work with your animated SVGs in conversation.

New in this version:

- Search SVGator's library of ready-made animation templates: loaders, icons, logos, UI elements and ad designs. Duplicate one to start from instead of animating from scratch.
- Filter the project list by folder, so larger accounts stay navigable.

What the plugin can do:

- Browse and open projects, each with a direct editor link.
- Inspect a project's element tree and read individual parts before changing anything.
- Make precise edits: recolor a shape, retime an animation, add or remove elements, or adjust a single keyframe.
- Create new projects, folders, and reusable assets, and duplicate or move existing projects.
- Export animated or static SVG (JS or CSS), React Native, Flutter, Lottie JSON, or a rendered MP4/GIF. Sync formats return a temporary download link; video and GIF run as render jobs polled until ready.
- Check your plan and export limits.

Credentials stay server-side and are never exposed to the model; ChatGPT only receives the results of the actions you request. Exports count against your SVGator plan's limits, exactly as they do in the editor.

Submission package 1.2.0: prepared for a fresh SVGator listing, corrected the category, provided a PNG icon, clarified subscription requirements, and made review expectations reproducible. Hosted MCP behavior is unchanged.
